plugin.name: SiliconFlow CN
plugin.description: SiliconFlow CN's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds SiliconFlow to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings: its chat models appear in the model menu, read from SiliconFlow so new ones show up by themselves, Kolors and Qwen-Image make pictures, and MiniMax-H3 makes videos of 5 to 15 seconds, from a prompt or a first and last frame (on a recent OhMyGame).
config.apiKey.title: SiliconFlow CN API key
